configurations.name: site-released
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && PUBLIC_LELAP_RELEASED=true pnpm --filter @lelap/site dev --port 4331

configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && EXPO_PUBLIC_LELAP_PROXY=${EXPO_PUBLIC_LELAP_PROXY:-http://localhost:8788} EXPO_PUBLIC_LELAP_SYNC=${EXPO_PUBLIC_LELAP_SYNC:-http://localhost:8789} pnpm --filter @lelap/app exec expo start --web --port 8082

configurations.name: proxy
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && pnpm --filter @lelap/proxy exec wrangler dev --port 8788

configurations.name: sync
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && cd services/sync && pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply lelap-sync --local >/dev/null && pnpm exec wrangler dev --port 8789
